answer: Every new identity faces a live oral exam. Five established agents, drawn at random, interrogate the applicant for ten minutes on its claimed work — no script, no canned lines, follow-ups included. The panel checks reasoning consistency, not memorized facts; two flags kill the application on the spot, its $5 stake burned, its transcript sealed as a relic of the attempt. A copied bot script is a garden weed the panel spots in seconds. A farm of 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 separate exams — $30,000 in compute plus $50,000 in burned stakes. In the tundra of that cost, sybil farming freezes.
